archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SWISS HIGH-CONTRAST (Developer Tools)
context: Marketing Landing Page for B2B SaaS Enterprise AI API Gateway

anti_slop_rules.typography_style: Sharp industrial monospace and geometric sans. 1px precise borders. Cloudflare/Linear/Vercel developer aesthetic.

typography.font_family_heading: JetBrains Mono, Geist Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace
typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-mono tracking-tight font-bold text-zinc-100
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-mono tracking-tight font-semibold text-zinc-100

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind scale (p-4, p-6, p-8, p-12, py-20, py-32)

navbar.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-md bg-zinc-950/80 border-b border-zinc-800/80 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between
elements: Get API Key button (solid Industrial Orange)

hero.style: pt-20 pb-16 text-left max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6
features: Kinetic line-by-line reveal animation on load using framer-motion
CTAs: Start Building (Primary Orange) and Read the Docs (Outline Zinc)

interactive_terminal.style: bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-lg overflow-hidden shadow-2xl font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm my-8
features: Execute / Run simulation button showing latency metric (e.g. 18ms, 200 OK)
Subtle 3D tilt movement on hover using mouse cursor coordinates

editorial_marquee.style: py-6 border-y border-zinc-800/60 bg-zinc-950/40 overflow-hidden font-mono text-xs tracking-widest text-zinc-500 uppercase

cards.title: Unified Model Routing
cards.description: Route requests dynamically across OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, and self-hosted models using a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint with automatic latency failover.

cards.title: Prompt Guardrails
cards.description: Enforce real-time PII redacting, regex blocking, maximum latency budgets, and safety evaluation pipelines inline before payloads reach downstream providers.

cards.title: Token & Cost Governance
cards.description: Set granular per-team budget limits, enforce client rate limits at the gateway layer, and stream real-time cost telemetry directly to Prometheus or Datadog.

elements: All Systems Operational status badge linked to /health with green indicator dot

motion_and_effects.scroll_reveal: staggered fade-up on viewport scroll using framer-motion initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }} whileInView={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
motion_and_effects.terminal_tilt: 3D perspective tilt effect on mouse movement using framer-motion useMotionValue and useTransform

instructions_to_main_agent: Build ONLY a React JS landing page for Tollgate in /app/frontend.
Follow dark zinc monochrome + industrial orange accent theme precisely.
Ensure absolutely zero forbidden buzzwords or em/en dashes in copy.
Implement Lenis smooth scroll and framer-motion line-by-line reveal.
Ensure interactive terminal has tab switching (cURL, Node.js, Python), run simulation with status 200 OK & latency, copy code to clipboard, and 3D tilt effect on hover.
Include every data-testid specified in required_data_testids.
